about: A non-normative profile: escrow behaviour that no clause of the KERI specification states, such as keeping an event that arrives before its prior event and accepting it when the prior event arrives. Every assertion is level INTEROP with a basis naming the inference it rests on, and passing it is never a conformance claim. The safety half of each scenario, that the early event is not accepted on arrival, is a MUST case in keri-1.0. This file is generated by scripts/regenerate from scenarios/keri/ and must not be edited. Fields: name; normative (false); basis (what the profile's expectations rest on); cases (the case ids, in order).
basis: Inference from the KERI specification v1.0.1 (tag v1.0.1, commit 71cb54ebb445dd9d8cb33cd29a5f50894fafc569): a validator that keeps an event it cannot accept yet, because its prior event or delegating seal has not been seen, can accept it once that arrives. The specification's only escrow obligation is for signature and witness threshold shortfalls (line 1266); no clause states this one.
name: keri-escrow
